title: Improved Implementation of Approximate Full Mass Matrix Inverse Methods into Material Point Method Simulations
summary: Approximate full mass matrix methods for the material point method, known as FMPM(k) of order k, can improve the calculation of grid velocities from grid momentum. It can be implemented in any MPM code by inserting a new calculation task whenever grid velocities are needed. The implementation recommended in this paper only needs these calculations once per time step just before when updating particle positions and velocities.
